scenes.title: CHATGPT IS FREE. WHO PAYS?
scenes.chat: Sure! Here is your whole essay, no charge...
scenes.say: ChatGPT is free. So who is paying for it?

scenes.title: ONLY ABOUT 5 IN 100 PAY
scenes.label: PAY FOR A PLAN, FROM $8 A MONTH
scenes.say: Reports say only about five in a hundred users pay. Plus is twenty dollars a month.

scenes.title: PAID PLANS: $8 TO $200
scenes.say: Plans start at eight dollars a month and go up to two hundred for the biggest Pro.

scenes.title: THE REST PAY WITH ATTENTION
scenes.say: Everyone else pays with attention. Free users in the US now see ads under answers. OpenAI says ads don't change the answer.

scenes.title: PAY $20 OR WATCH ADS?
scenes.say: And running AI is pricey. So pay twenty, or watch ads? Comment which.
